scientific_integrity: The threshold is a known kind of susceptibility-weighted spectral criterion. The specifically assessed contribution is its endogenous strictly polarized realization, matching mean vaccination/opinion, minimal 6-node opposite-verdict witness and unbounded family; priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Local deterministic discrete-time MMCA invasion stability only; strict binary clipped opinions; common undirected social and contact graph; 6-node minimality limited to strict mixed-sign saturation; does not establish global nonlinear epidemic behavior, stochastic outbreak likelihood, or threshold-equality stability.
title: Equal vaccination coverage, opposite invasion verdicts: a sharp six-vertex construction
